definitions.explanation: A water-based skincare product applied to the face after washing to hydrate and prepare the skin for further care. A staple in Japanese skincare routines for both men and women.

examples.japanese: {化粧水|けしょうすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
⟦{洗顔|せんがん}→洗顔：21254_sengan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{化粧水|けしょうすい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧。
examples.english: After washing my face, I prepare my skin with toner.

examples.japanese: ⟦{乾燥肌|かんそうはだ}→乾燥肌：16609_kansouhada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{保湿|ほしつ}→保湿：11617_hoshitsu⟧{力|りょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{化粧水|けしょうすい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おすすめ→おすすめ：09746_osusume⟧です。
examples.english: For dry skin, a toner with strong moisturizing power is recommended.

notes:
USAGE:
{化粧水|けしょうすい} is applied by patting it onto the face with the hands or a cotton pad. In the Japanese skincare routine, it comes after ⟦{洗顔|せんがん}→洗顔：21254_sengan⟧ (face washing) and before ⟦{乳液|にゅうえき}→乳液：16091_nyuueki⟧ (moisturizing milk) or ⟦{美容液|びようえき}→美容液：16608_biyoueki⟧ (serum).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {化粧水|けしょうすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (apply face lotion)
- {化粧水|けしょうすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧ (put on face lotion)
- ⟦{保湿|ほしつ}→保湿：11617_hoshitsu⟧{化粧水|けしょうすい} (moisturizing toner)
- {化粧水|けしょうすい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧ (prepare the skin with toner)
